translations.web: I give a judgment in this: for this is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.
translations.bsb: And this is my opinion about what is helpful for you in this matter: Last year you were the first not only to give, but even to have such a desire.
translations.kjv: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.
translations.asv: And herein I give my judgment: for this is expedient for you, who were the first to make a beginning a year ago, not only to do, but also to will.
